in_sanskrit.name: Mithinga
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweetness, Delicacy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mithinga एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mithila', meaning sweet, delicate, and charming. In Hindu mythology, Mithila is also the name of the sacred land where Lord Rama and Sita got married.

in_hindi.name: Mithinga
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweetness, Delicacy

In Hindu mythology, Mithila is also the name of the sacred land where Lord Rama and Sita got married.
